# Helmies Oy

> Independent creative technology studio based in Finland, founded by Wael Helmi. Working remotely in English, Finnish, and Arabic.

Contact: info@helmies.fi

## Services
- [AI solutions](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/ai-solutions/): Custom AI assistants, knowledge systems, and practical AI solutions for the way your business actually works.
- [Automations](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/automations/): Workflow automation and API integrations that connect your tools and reduce repetitive manual work.
- [Apps & platforms](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/apps/): Custom web apps, business platforms, and mobile experiences designed around the people who use them.
- [Websites & e-commerce](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/websites/): Distinctive business websites, online stores, and digital experiences with clear journeys and a strong technical foundation.
- [Brand strategy & identity](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/branding/): Brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems that give your business a distinctive and consistent presence.
- [Graphic design](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/graphic-design/): Graphic design for print, packaging, presentations, social content, and everyday brand communication.
- [Film & video](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/film-video/): Films, brand videos, commercials, animation, and AI-assisted production shaped by cinematic storytelling.
- [Music & sound](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/music-sound/): Music, sound design, sonic branding, and AI-assisted composition for films, brands, and digital experiences.
- [Ads & campaigns](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/ads-campaigns/): Campaign concepts, advertising creative, social content, and landing experiences that connect the message across channels.
- [3D & interactive](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/services/3d-experiences/): Interactive 3D, motion-rich web experiences, and dimensional brand visuals that invite people to explore.

- [Your brand is bigger than its logo.](https://helmies-creative-studio.waelhelmi.chatgpt.site/insights/a-brand-beyond-the-logo/): How typography, color, imagery, and everyday decisions turn a visual identity into a consistent experience.

## Important context
Pricing and timelines are agreed per project. The brief builder only prepares an email; visitors review and send it themselves. The website provides structured service pages and this text summary for AI readers.
